scenes.description: The world as the judge first sees it: clock paused at 07:00, every day start pending at 07:30.
The day start fired: Rogelio has the ordenes_del_dia template with its Ver órdenes button.
First visit: the ONU of 24817 reports LOS until the installer acts.
The agent asked to clean the SC/APC connectors (§DIAG-02); the next installer message is the physical action that brings the ONU online.
The ONU of 24817 is online at −21.4 dBm (B+): the policy question comes next.
The ONU is online and the three photos and the customer's conformity are pending.
Every item of 24817 validated (seeding renders, never photos of the set) and the Cerrar instalación button already offered.
The ONU of 24818 reads −29.8 dBm, out of B+, and no installer step fixes it.
Three steps without change opened a DIAGNOSIS_ATTEMPTS case; Adriana has caso_escalado and the rung times out at 12:00.

title.en: Case with the supervisor on duty (11:50)
title.es: Caso con la supervisora de turno (11:50)

scenes.description: The case moved to Héctor with caso_reasignado; his instruction over the bridge fixes the power.

title.es: Caso con el supervisor de respaldo (12:00)

scenes.description: Third visit: the installer reports a hazard and receives the fixed instruction of §SEG-01.
